Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Official Flight Club Trailer
recentItems.description: Take a look at the Flight Club Trailer for Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve, the latest addition to the hit aviation action simulation shooter developed by Bandi Namco Aces. Players can get key teachings from Flight Club, led by MoistCr1tikal, to take your openings, dodge incoming missiles, and rule the skies. Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Can These Wrestlers Take On LA Comic Con At Super Smash Bros Ultimate? - Get the Squad Back Together
recentItems.description:
Last time on IGN’s Get the Squad Back Together – we assembled Austin Creed, Kofi Kingston, and Ify Nwadiwe aka Team OSB to band together to take on the world at Super Smash Bros. Ultimate…or at least, just LA Comic Con attendees.

Together with IGN’s Alan Knight – the squad journeyed to the LA Convention Center in style courtesy of the Toyota Grand Highlander Platinum or as we like to call it, the official IGN Mobile Gaming Studio.

Now, with the Squad boots on the ground at LA Comic Con and the Mobile Gaming Studio setup and ready for action, our heroes warm up before the main event… This Is IGN’s Get the Squad Back Together.
#ToyotaPartner

recentItems.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 - Official Commander Edition Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Commander Edition Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, the upcoming real-time strategy game developed by King Art. Players can get the rundown on the Commander Edition, including three days of early access, a digital soundtrack, a playable faction, campaign expansion, and more for players to enjoy. The Commander Edition for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 is available now, with the game launching on December 3 for PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Avengers Doomsday - Official Final Trailer (2026) Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth
recentItems.description:
Don't miss this all new trailer for Marvel Studios Avengers Doomsday. With the Multiverse collapsing and incursion events happening across the Multiverse, heroes from different worlds must fight to save their realities. At the center of this conflict is Doctor Doom, the ruler of Latveria, a brilliant scientist and master of the occult, who will be instrumental in the events to come. 

Avengers Doomsday brings Marvel's Multiverse Saga to a close, led by a massive cast featuring Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Chris Hemsworth, Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Florence Pugh, Channing Tatum, Simu Liu, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Lewis Pullman, Winston Duke, Ian McKellan, James Marsden, Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom and the final performance of the late Sir Patrick Stuart as Charles Xavier. 

Avengers Doomsday arrives in theaters of December 18th 2026.

recentItems.title: Teardown - Official Rally Mode Release Date Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out the Rally Mode Release Date Trailer for Teardown, a voxel-based adventure game developed by Tuxedo Labs. Players can take to the track to race for voxel glory. Take on a suite of maps, dodge explosions, and get first place. The Rally Mode for Teardown is launching on December 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#IGN #gaming

recentItems.title: Wingsuit Simulator - Official Reveal Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Wingsuit Simulator, a physics-based wingsuit simulation game developed by Becoming Games. Players will thread the needle at breakneck speeds to rapidly descend by way of a wingsuit. Squeeze into gaps, skim cliffs, and walk the line between life and death. Wingsuit Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#WingsuitSimulator #Gaming #IGN

recentItems.title: Wardens of Avalon - Official Exploration and Combat Gameplay Developer Overview Video
recentItems.description:
Get a look at the Exploration and Combat Gameplay Developer Overview Video for Wardens of Avalon, an upcoming action-adventure RPG developed by Runes Studio. Players can get an extensive look at the sprawling world of Wardens of Avalon to see what's out there to discover, get the rundown on the basics of combat, including parries, blocks, and attacks, and more to experience at the full release. Wardens of Avalon is launching on February 9 for PC (Steam).\

#WardensOfAvalon #Gaming #IGN

recentItems.title: Astrider - Official Demo Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for Astrider, an arcade action dog fighting game developed by Sanguine Horse Studio. Players will take on a suite of missions to take out targets on land, at sea, and in the air. Astrider is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
